_comment: Protein coverage of each pLM embedding set over the sprot_pre2024 cohort. Cached so the UpSet figure can be regenerated and iterated on WITHOUT cluster access: the .h5 files live on LRZ/Zenodo and enumerating 542k HDF5 group keys takes ~3 min per file over GPFS.
state: PRE-FIX: esm2_3b was mid-completion (LRZ job 5732148). See esm2_3b_note.
esm2_3b_note: 435,298 of 542,238 = an interrupted run, not a length filter: present vs missing length distributions are indistinguishable (median 295 vs 296, p95 860 vs 864) and the longest protein (13,477 aa) was embedded. Once completed, the all-arm intersection rises 422,972 -> 526,871.

cause_by_tier.542237: one protein short - the single 9-arm-missing outlier
cause_by_tier.526871: ESM-1b positional cap of 1022 tokens; CLEAN inherits it (built on ESM-1b)

patterns_note: key = bitmask over `models` (bit i set => present in models[i]); value = number of proteins with exactly that membership.
